criteria.criterion: The run lock (.vloop/tmp/.running) keeps its fields and also records phase (plan, gate review, work or review), task (absent for plan and gate review), session_started (RFC 3339 UTC) and spent, updated as each session starts and ends.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/safety.go lockRecord gains phase/task/session_started/spent (omitempty); internal/driver/session.go updates the lock at session start and in a defer at end; TestSessionRecordsItselfInTheRunLock reads the lock during and after the session and checks the old fields survive.

criteria.criterion: vloop status, while a live run holds the lock, prints after its first line `running: <phase>[ <task>] for <m>m<ss>s · $<spent> of $<ceiling>`; with no plan yet but a live run planning, it prints the running line and exits 0.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/status.go runningLine prints the line after the header; the ErrNoPlan branch prints only the running line and returns nil; TestStatusRunningLine and TestStatusRunningWhilePlanning match the format by regexp.

criteria.criterion: vloop status --json gains "running": {"phase", "task", "session_started", "spent", "ceiling"}, absent when no live run holds the lock — a lock whose process is gone is not a live run.
criteria.evidence: runningJSON is omitempty on the status object; driver.ReadRunning returns false unless processAlive(pid); TestStatusNoRunningWithoutLiveRun covers no lock and a dead pid.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests cover the lock's new fields, the running line during a session and while planning, and its absence with no live run or a stale lock. The status tests (internal/cli/status_test.go) change only where a live lock is planted; docs/guide/commands.md is regenerated if any help text changed.
criteria.evidence: The diff to status_test.go and session_test.go is additions only; no pre-existing test is edited. The help text is unchanged and docs/ is untouched.

criteria.criterion: No refactor from B15's list is folded in.
criteria.evidence: The diff has only the lock, Run and status changes plus the small encodeJSON helper used by the new code.

notes: Spec gap: the ceiling is read from config in status, so a --cost-ceiling flag override on the run is not reflected in the running line. Between sessions the phase is empty and the line prints 'running: between sessions', which the brief does not specify.
